annotations.title: Vendor Onboarding — one decision, only the exceptions

description: Vendor onboarding in one payment: registry check, trust record and the $1 DD scan, plus an optional wallet sanctions screen and a near-duplicate check against your vendor list. Returns onboarding.decision (CLEAR | EXCEPTION | STOP) and only the exceptions a human must resolve, with a per-step baseline. The $99 deep vetting is opt-in (skip_deep_vetting=false). Stops if the registry page does not name the vendor. Unexecuted steps are refunded. (x402: $90.10 USDC per call)
name: bundle.vendor-vetting
